name: progestnow-agents
description: Interroga e opera sul gestionale ProgestNOW dalla chat: documenti commerciali, scadenzario, statistiche, TabellaBase, agenda e attività, con le procedure corrette per il tenant collegato.

interface.shortDescription: ERP data and actions in chat
interface.longDescription: Use your ProgestNOW ERP from ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live business data: revenue by customer, open orders, overdue invoices, payments and receipts, sales statistics, commissions, agenda and tasks. Turn results into tables and dashboards, prepare for a customer meeting with a one-page summary, or create quotes, orders and tasks directly in the ERP. Every action respects the user's ProgestNOW permissions and data visibility rules; nothing is created or changed without the user's confirmation, and every operation is logged. Requires a ProgestNOW account with the AI integration enabled by your company administrator.

How much have we invoiced this year compared to last year?
